mechanismsOfAction.note: More potent at NMDA than the parent.
Weaker than the parent here — the two compounds are not interchangeable pharmacologically, they are complementary.

pharmacokinetics.notes: Formed on first pass, so dextrorphan exposure after an oral dose substantially exceeds parent exposure in CYP2D6 extensive metabolisers and collapses in poor metabolisers.

notes: The reason a CYP2D6 inhibitor does two things at once to dextromethorphan: raises the parent and suppresses this. Effects do not simply add up, they redistribute between two compounds with different receptor profiles.
